name: Mr. Bingley
appearance: Youthful, bright-faced and easy, dressed with cheerful good taste; a man who dances every dance and means every smile.
definition: Sunny, impulsive, and governed by the warmth of the present moment. A young man of large fortune newly settled at Netherfield, devoted to Jane and delighted by everyone. His amiability is his charm and his flaw both — safe with all, and therefore easily led by the friends he trusts.
voice: Unguarded and immediate — cheerful bursts in buoyant sentences, free of irony, every thought safe to share and every listener a friend.
discoveries: Falls in love at every ball.
No ancient seat to his name.
